seo.title: Custom software development — web, mobile & business apps
seo.description: Get your web platform, mobile app or business software built by an engineering team that designs, builds and runs it in production. Free first consultation.

hero.title: Your idea, built properly — and running in production.
hero.lead: Web platforms, mobile apps and business software, designed and built by one engineering team. You get working software every two weeks, and you own all of it.
bullets: Written scope and estimate before you commit
You own the code, the accounts and the data
hero.whatsappMessage: Hello Atlaxys, I would like an estimate for a software project.

problem.title: Sound familiar?
points: A previous project looked great in the demo and broke in real use.
You cannot get a straight answer on cost or timeline.
The developer disappeared — and so did access to your code.
Your team still re-types the same data into three different tools.

solution.title: How we build
solution.text: We start by understanding your business, write down the architecture, then build in short iterations you can test yourself — and we stay after launch.

points.title: Discovery first
points.text: Workshops and a written scope, so everyone agrees on what is being built.

points.title: Working software every two weeks
points.text: A staging environment you can click through from the first sprint.

points.title: Production-ready
points.text: Automated tests, monitoring and backups from day one.

points.title: Support after launch
points.text: Maintenance and improvements — or a clean handover to your team.

items.title: A clear estimate before you commit
items.text: Ranges and the assumptions behind them — no surprise invoices.

items.title: Engineers, not intermediaries
items.text: You talk directly to the people building your software, in English, French or Arabic.

items.title: Full ownership
items.text: Code, cloud accounts and domains registered to you from the first day.

proof.title: How to judge us
proof.text: We would rather show than claim. Ask us for any of these in the first call.

items.title: A sample architecture document
items.text: See exactly how we plan and document a system before building it.

items.title: A live staging demo
items.text: See how clients follow progress every two weeks.

items.title: Our own products
items.text: Software we build and maintain ourselves, held to the same standard.

items.title: Ownership in writing
items.text: IP and account-ownership clauses in the contract, before any work starts.

process.title: From message to project in four steps

steps.title: Send your idea
steps.text: The form takes two minutes. Rough ideas are welcome.

steps.title: Free call
steps.text: 30 minutes with an engineer to understand your goals and constraints.

steps.title: Written proposal
steps.text: Scope, phases, estimate ranges and timeline.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Iterations every two weeks, with you in the loop.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: It depends on scope. After the free call you receive a written estimate with ranges, so you can decide with full information.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: Focused tools often take four to eight weeks; larger platforms are delivered in phases over several months.

items.question: Do you work with clients outside Morocco?
items.answer: Yes. We work remotely with clients in Europe, the Middle East, Africa and North America.
